title: Positive frames and paid clones on skip-prefix graphs for a conditional κ = 4.548671376e-5 bound
body:
**Full verification PASSED** at research commit `bcb33f4fde2d07b11f0eee98f089e506dfc24e2f`. PR #51's exact profiler in `fixed` mode reproduced both pinned profile arrays (85,355 matrices/10 primes at h23; 113,893 matrices/11 primes at h25). Full `make verify` then passed: **211 tests**, four focused tests, fresh producer/clone/compiler checks, inherited data geometry and **18 historical patch checks**, in 559.0 seconds. [Validation receipt](https://github.com/rohanarun/integer-mult-bounds/blob/research/positive-skip/research/positive-skip/validation.json), [exact profile receipt](https://github.com/rohanarun/integer-mult-bounds/blob/research/positive-skip/research/positive-skip/exact-recertification.json). Log SHA256 `517669ce9a04cf66afa407ddd0dd3f5da8cb79cfefc3cf64365c56cccf4b9000`. Follow-up changes are documentation and validation metadata only.

Under the inherited analytic and fixed finite-alphabet multitape hypotheses,

$$T(n)=O(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}),\qquad\kappa=\frac{4548671376}{10^{14}}=4.548671376\times10^{-5}.$$

This is **0.4334% above PR #54** (`141532521/3125000000000`) and **1.1233% above PR #53** (`4498144/10^11`). The bit saving is `4548878290/10^14`; W = **159,509,439**. These compare conditional asymptotic exponents, not measured speedups or a verified global best.

## Construction

Combine PR #53's skip-prefix scalar graphs with PR #51's backward-positive labels and paid whole-chain clone search (limit 4, policy `late`, rank-node matcher, repeated until no clone remains). Weighted carrier matching is then selected under the positive-frame adjacency.

| Dimension | Roles before | Roles after |
|---|---:|---:|
| h23 | 32,946 | **32,693** |
| h25 | 43,409 | **43,009** |

PR #54 applies paid clones to #53 using original-envelope frames. This candidate uses enlarged positive frames. Both bases remain fixed I+J; the construction retains #53's data-corner geometry, paid costs, complex layer and downstream pipeline.

Numerically weighted matching is a discovery procedure; exact replay must certify the pinned result. No exact weighted-matching optimality, global optimality, or priority claim is made.

## Verification

Independent local checks confirmed:

- `build.py` reconstructs DAGs, labels, clone rounds and pinned digests.
- PR #51's independent compiler checks scalar identity, rational frames, physical compilation and rank timelines at both dimensions.
- `tools/cprof.cpp` reproduces #53's certified I+J profiles and #51's certified negative-basis profiles.
- `witness.py` checks the exact moment, 47 strict constraints and seven margins, rejects the next grid points, and excludes #53 and #54 with exact lower moments.

Run `make positive-skip-verify`. The exact profiler replay and full `make verify` have passed as recorded above. Finite replay does not establish the inherited general analytic and physical interfaces, which still require mathematical review.
